parameters.name: plate_size
parameters.description: The size of the grid plate to generate

parameters.name: bed_size
parameters.description: The bed size of the printer, e.g. 250x220 for the Prusa Core One

parameters.name: magnets
parameters.description: Whether to enable friction-fit magnets for each grid cell

parameters.name: magnet_style
parameters.description: Magnet style

parameters.name: magnet_frame_style
parameters.description: Style of the magnet level

parameters.name: magnet_diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of the magnet slot

parameters.name: magnet_height
parameters.description: Height of the magnet slot

parameters.name: magnet_top
parameters.description: Wall above the magnet. Should be small for maximum magnet strength

parameters.name: magnet_bottom
parameters.description: Floor below the magnet. Not structurally important, should be small to minimize filament use

parameters.name: magnet_border
parameters.description: Horizontal strength of the frame holding the magnet in place

parameters.name: magnet_release_width
parameters.description: Width of the magnet release slot

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: Enable the click latch. WARNING: The plastic can deform over time, do not use PLA! PETG might be fine, but there are no long-term tests yet

parameters.name: click_style
parameters.description: Style of the click latch. The traditional arc style is more robust. The newer ClickGroove design can reduce creep when used with compatible bins, but still supports standard bins.

parameters.name: click1_distance
parameters.description: Distance that the click latch extends into the bin area

parameters.name: click1_steepness
parameters.description: Steepness of the click latch arc

parameters.name: click1_outer_length
parameters.description: Length of the full click latch

parameters.name: click1_inner_length
parameters.description: Length of the straight piece in the middle of the click latch. The arced pieces take up the remaining space

parameters.name: click1_height
parameters.description: Height of the click latch

parameters.name: click1_strength
parameters.description: Thickness of the click latch. This is measured from the bottom of the baseplate profile

parameters.name: click1_wall_strength
parameters.description: Thickness of the non-bending wall behind the click latch. This wall provides stability and prevents the click latch from bending too far

parameters.name: clickgroove_gap_length
parameters.description: Length of the gap behind the click latch

parameters.name: clickgroove_tab_length
parameters.description: Length of the tab that engages with the bin groove

parameters.name: clickgroove_strength
parameters.description: Thickness of the click latch. This is measured from the bottom of the baseplate profile

parameters.name: clickgroove_wall_strength
parameters.description: Thickness of the non-bending wall behind the click latch. This wall provides stability and prevents the click latch from bending too far

parameters.name: clickgroove_depth
parameters.description: How far the tab protudes from the normal baseplate profile. Increasing this produces a more secure fit

parameters.name: connector_intersection_puzzle
parameters.description: Enable the intersection puzzle plate connector. This is similar to GridPlates/GRIPS. Small puzzle connectors are added cell intersections.

parameters.name: intersection_puzzle_fit
parameters.description: A value from 0 to 1 to modify the fit of the intersection puzzle connector. 0 is a loose fit, 1 is a tight fit.

parameters.name: connector_edge_puzzle
parameters.description: Enable the edge puzzle plate connector. This connector is a bit cleaner, but is harder to print, especially when magnets are disabled (not enough vertical space). It's also more customizable, so you can tune the fit to your printer.

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_count
parameters.description: Number of puzzle connectors per cell

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_dim
parameters.description: Dimensions of the male puzzle connector (main piece)

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_dim_c
parameters.description: Dimensions of the male puzzle connector (bridge to plate)

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_gap
parameters.description: Clearance of the puzzle connector. The female side is larger than the above dimensions by this amount

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_magnet_border
parameters.description: If magnets are enabled, use the vertical space to add a border to the female puzzle socket, for added stability and better printability

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_magnet_border_width
parameters.description: Size of the added border

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_height_female
parameters.description: Height of the edge puzzle connector (female side, male is smaller by edge_puzzle_height_male_delta). You can set this to the full height, but make sure that no pieces of the segment remain unconnected!

parameters.name: edge_puzzle_height_male_delta
parameters.description: Male side of the edge puzzle connector is smaller than the female side by this amount

parameters.name: filler_x
parameters.description: When there is not enough room for a full cell, fill the remaining space with a half-width or dynamic width cell (x direction)

parameters.name: filler_y
parameters.description: When there is not enough room for a full cell, fill the remaining space with a half-width or dynamic width cell (y direction)

parameters.name: filler_fraction
parameters.description: Integer fraction of the reduced size cells, e.g. a value of 2 produces half-width cells, a value of 3 produces third-width cells

parameters.name: filler_minimum_size
parameters.description: Minimum size of filler cells in dynamic mode. If a filler cell would be smaller than this value, it is added to the previous cell instead, producing a cell that is larger than 42mm

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.description: Padding alignment. The first value is the x direction (east/west), the second value the y direction (north/south). When padding is added to the build plate, this alignment is used to distribute it. A lower value will move the grid towards the west/south direction, adding more padding to the east/north

parameters.name: hollow
parameters.description: Skeletonize the baseplate: instead of solid material between the cells, only a thin wall following the gridfinity profile is printed. This roughly halves filament use and print time. Incompatible with magnets, a solid base and the click latch

parameters.name: hollow_wall
parameters.description: Wall thickness in hollow mode. This is a horizontal thickness, which is what the slicer sees on each layer, so a value matching your nozzle diameter prints as a single wall

parameters.name: remove_bottom_lip
parameters.description: Remove the bottom lip of the gridfinity profile, extending the vertical section of the profile straight down instead. The lip is not functionally required; removing it saves filament, removes the overhang between neighbouring cells, and widens the first layer. Always enabled in hollow mode

parameters.name: numbering
parameters.description: Enable numbering of the segements, embossed in a corner

parameters.name: number_depth
parameters.description: Depth of the embossing

parameters.name: number_size
parameters.description: Font size of the numbers

parameters.name: number_font
parameters.description: Font

parameters.name: number_squeeze_size
parameters.description: When a segment is very narrow, use this reduced number size. Should rarely be relevant

parameters.name: bottom_chamfer
parameters.description: Chamfer at the bottom edge of the plate. Configurable for each edge individually (clockwise: north, east, south, west)

parameters.name: top_chamfer
parameters.description: Chamfer at the top edge of the plate. Configurable for each edge individually (clockwise: north, east, south, west)

parameters.name: plate_wall_thickness
parameters.description: Plate wall thickness. Can be specified for each direction individually (north, east, south, west). Note that this is *added* to the plate_size

parameters.name: plate_wall_height
parameters.description: Plate wall height. The first value is the height above the plate, the second value the height below the plate

parameters.name: plate_wall_above
parameters.description: Variable wall height, above the plate. Specified for each corner individually. Corners are SW, NW, NE, SE.

parameters.name: plate_wall_below
parameters.description: Variable wall height, below the plate. Specified for each corner individually. Corners are SW, NW, NE, SE.

parameters.name: adapter_north
parameters.description: Generate openGrid adapters on the north wall. Requires a plate wall of sufficient height/thickness on that side

parameters.name: adapter_east
parameters.description: Generate openGrid adapters on the east wall. Requires a plate wall of sufficient height/thickness on that side

parameters.name: adapter_south
parameters.description: Generate openGrid adapters on the south wall. Requires a plate wall of sufficient height/thickness on that side

parameters.name: adapter_west
parameters.description: Generate openGrid adapters on the west wall. Requires a plate wall of sufficient height/thickness on that side

parameters.name: adapter_mode
parameters.description: Style of the openGrid adapter. The plain openGrid connectors can be printed directly, in normal or 'lite' strength, and in a directional or non-directional variant. The 'vertical' variants of each cut a 45° angle to allow printing without supports, at the cost of reduced strength. The openConnect variants instead cut a slot for a separately printed openConnect connector, which is the recommended option

parameters.name: vertical_screw_style
parameters.description: Type of the holes at cell intersections. Screw holes go through the plate to screw it down. Magnet pockets are cut from the bottom, and hold the plate in place on a metal surface, e.g. a steel drawer

parameters.name: vertical_screw_diameter
parameters.description: Radius of vertical screws

parameters.name: vertical_screw_countersink_top
parameters.description: Top countersink dimension. First value is the diameter of the screw head, second value the height

parameters.name: vertical_screw_counterbore_top
parameters.description: Top counterbore dimension. First value is the diameter of the screw head, second value the height

parameters.name: vertical_screw_magnet_diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of the magnet pocket

parameters.name: vertical_screw_magnet_height
parameters.description: Height of the magnet pocket

parameters.name: vertical_screw_magnet_floor
parameters.description: Floor below the magnet pocket. At 0, the pocket is open at the bottom and the magnets are glued or pressed in from below. With a thin floor, the magnets can be embedded using a print pause, or inserted from the top if the pocket height exceeds the plate height

parameters.name: vertical_screw_magnet_release_diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of a small hole through the whole plate at the magnet pocket, used to push the magnet out with a needle. Set to 0 to disable

parameters.name: vertical_screw_plate_corners
parameters.description: Enable screws at *plate* corners

parameters.name: vertical_screw_plate_corner_inset
parameters.description: Distance from the edge (in number of cells) for an intersection to qualify as a plate corner

parameters.name: vertical_screw_plate_edges
parameters.description: Enable screws at *plate* edges

parameters.name: vertical_screw_segment_corners
parameters.description: Enable screws at *segment* corners that are not also plate corners

parameters.name: vertical_screw_segment_corner_inset
parameters.description: Distance from the edge (in number of cells) for an intersection to qualify as a segment corner

parameters.name: vertical_screw_segment_edges
parameters.description: Enable screws at *segment* edges (will interfere with intersection connectors!)

parameters.name: vertical_screw_other
parameters.description: Enable screws at all other intersections

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_wall_north
parameters.description: Enable horizontal screws on the north edge

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_wall_east
parameters.description: Enable horizontal screws on the east edge

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_wall_south
parameters.description: Enable horizontal screws on the south edge

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_wall_west
parameters.description: Enable horizontal screws on the west edge

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_diameter
parameters.description: Radius of vertical screws

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_countersink_top
parameters.description: Top countersink dimension. First value is the diameter of the screw head, second value the height

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_counterbore_top
parameters.description: Top counterbore dimension. First value is the diameter of the screw head, second value the height

parameters.name: horizontal_screw_offset
parameters.description: Shift the screw location by a predetermined offset

parameters.name: thumbscrews
parameters.description: Generate thumb screw cutouts compatible with 'Gridfinity Refined'. This requires solid_base or magnets with solid frame style

parameters.name: thumbscrew_diameter
parameters.description: Thumb screw cutout diameter

parameters.name: x_segment_algorithm
parameters.description: Select the algorithm for splitting the baseplate into segments along the x axis. The default ideal algorithm splits the plate into roughly equally-sized segments. The incremental algorithm produces as many maximum-size segments as possible, and one smaller segment for the remaining cells.

parameters.name: y_row_count_first
parameters.description: In the y direction, segment sizes are determined by a simple algorithm that only resizes the first and last segments. The number of rows for the first segment alternate to avoid 4-way intersections. You can override the number of rows in the start segment for the odd and even columns with this property

parameters.name: x_column_count_first
parameters.description: If the 'incremental' x segment algorithm is chosen, this can be used to override the column count in the first segment.

parameters.name: separate_edge_padding
parameters.description: Generate positive edge padding as separate printable pieces instead of attaching it to the outer baseplate segments.

parameters.name: stacked_print
parameters.description: Enable stacked printing of segments in a single print

parameters.name: stacked_print_layer_height
parameters.description: Layer height for stacked prints. GridFlock will ensure that each segment is placed at a multiple of this layer height, for consistent printing.

parameters.name: stacked_print_min_gap
parameters.description: The minimum vertical gap between segments, in layers (as per stacked_print_layer_height). The actual gap will be somewhere between stacked_print_min_gap and 1+stacked_print_min_gap layers

parameters.name: stacked_print_duplicates
parameters.description: How many times each segment should appear in the stack. If you set this to 2 for example, you can assemble two full baseplates from the final result.

parameters.name: stacked_print_flip_first
parameters.description: Flip the first (lowest) segment?

parameters.name: stacked_print_flip
parameters.description: Flip the other segments?

parameters.name: stacked_print_slice
parameters.description: In order to get better contact area for the stacked print, cut off this much from the top of the baseplate.

parameters.name: solid_base
parameters.description: Thickness of the optional solid base

parameters.name: plate_corner_radius
parameters.description: Corner radius of the generated plate. The default of 4mm matches the corner radius of the gridfinity cell

parameters.name: edge_adjust
parameters.description: Edge adjustment values (clockwise: north, east, south, west). These values are *added* to the plate size as padding, i.e. the final plate will end up different than configured in plate_size. This allows you to customize the padding to be asymmetrical. You can also use negative values to "cut" the plate edges if you want to squeeze an extra square out of limited space.

parameters.name: cell_override
parameters.description: Override the content of individual cells. Each character in this string modifies one cell. The order goes from west to east, then south to north. A 'c' stands for a normal cell. An 's' stands for a solid plate without a cell cutout. An 'e' stands for an empty square

parameters.name: top_slice
parameters.description: Cut off a bit of the top of the baseplate. This can be used to increase contact area when printing the plate upside down.

parameters.name: test_pattern
parameters.description: Test patterns
